description:
6th Leduc Mixed Doubles Wheelchair Curling Event
Only complete team entries (ie one female and one male) will be accepted.
National and Provincial/Territorial representation will be taken into consideration based on the number of registered teams.
Athletes are not required to play with a teammate from the same country or province/territory.
Location:  Leduc Curling Club, Leduc, AB
Format:  Mixed Doubles (8-end games)
Round Robin and playoffs - number of games based on number of teams
100% of entry fees will be put towards the purse.
Purse will be based on entry fees.
name: 2027 Leduc Mixed Doubles Wheelchair Curling Event
summary: Leduc Mixed Doubles  Wheelchair Curling Event Sponsored by the National Wheelchair Curling Program
